notes.title: Update
notes.content: This update brings many new features to Aston! You can now save your in-game progress, allowing you to continue where you left off. The game's performance has been optimized, and FPS rates have been increased for a smoother experience. Additionally, many bugs have been fixed, minimizing in-game errors. The user interface has also undergone significant improvements, making it more user-friendly and modern. With new content, missions, and special events added, the game has become even richer. Enjoy the game and don't forget to share your feedback!
